prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” interior painter for all St. Louis homes, but **CertaPro Painters of St. Louis** is a reasonable first company to contact if you want an established, full-service option with formal estimates, scheduling, and warranty processes.

For a better “best for your project” choice, get 2–3 written bids and compare:

- Prep work included: patching, sanding, caulk, primer, furniture protection  
- Paint brand, line, sheen, and number of coats  
- Proof of liability and workers’ comp insurance  
- Recent reviews specifically mentioning interior work and cleanup  
- Written warranty and clear change-order pricing  
- EPA lead-safe certification if your home was built before 1978  

For many St. Louis homeowners, a well-reviewed independent local painter can outperform a franchise on craftsmanship and price—so don’t select solely on star rating or lowest bid. If you share your neighborhood, room count, and whether walls/trim/cabinets are involved, I can help you narrow the type of company and a fair price range.
